metadata.name: Peek Blob
metadata.description: A shy glowing blob peeks over a ledge. Its egg eyes trail your cursor with springy lag, it blinks and breathes softly, and it ducks when you tap it. More like this, plus a designer your coding agent can use, at studios.lou15.com/?ref=21st
metadata.author: louisstudios
